item.description: In a statement on Instagram, Grammy-winning musician Macklemore says he was forced out of Ed Sheeran’s “Loop Tour,” after Patriots owner Robert Kraft organized a boycott among stadium owners to get him removed over his on-stage pro-Palestine remarks.
